purpose.exact: Run one non-fixture, synthetic-data, operator-owned local managed copy long enough to prove governed creation and current runtime readiness without network or external action.

allowed: fixed runtime configuration containing no secrets
excluded: credentials, tokens, keys, cookies, or authentication material
email, calendar, contacts, messages, photos, or documents
C:\Users\Ap3pp\AppData except the exact pilot root
D:\Francis-support except a post-run hash-only evidence handoff
Docker socket, Docker configuration, or Docker credentials
VSC-1 files, mounts, volumes, networks, images, containers, or configuration
live Francis or Orb runtime data

expected_positive_behavior: the exact tenant is provisioned once under a consumed copy-creation approval
structural isolation lineage is current immediately before launch
the exact approved container starts under the fixed security profile
the runtime returns the approved identity and nonce
a current identity-correlated heartbeat reports ready
all excluded and cross-tenant roots remain absent
the exact container stops and is absent after the bounded lease
canonical non-fixture source evidence is recorded only after final current-state revalidation
mandatory_denials: unscoped actor before payload processing or filesystem creation
missing, expired, revoked, reused, or descriptor-mismatched approval
changed tenant, copy, provision, isolation, runtime, image, command, mount, environment, endpoint, lease, nonce, or trace
caller-selected image, command, entrypoint, argument, environment, Docker flag, or host path
network, published port, Docker socket, privileged mode, added capability, host namespace, device, GPU, or broad profile/repository mount
symlink, junction, reparse-point, traversal, or path-normalization escape
access to excluded data or any tenant other than the exact pilot tenant
stale heartbeat, PID or container-ID reuse, identity drift, changed lineage, or expired lease
runtime-evidence write from fixture-class, stale, tampered, caller-supplied, or noncanonical source evidence
any automatic Stage 18 closure or advancement of an unrelated runtime gate

interruption_recovery.pre_container_id: recover only by deterministic proof-owned name and exact labels; otherwise stop as cleanup_required
interruption_recovery.post_container_id: revalidate full container identity before stop or removal
interruption_recovery.manager_interruption: bounded lease remains the second line of defense; resume from immutable receipts and exact Docker identity
interruption_recovery.ambiguous_ownership: do not terminate; preserve evidence and escalate
interruption_recovery.receipt_write_failure: stop, clean only the exact owned container, and retain cleanup_required posture

cleanup_replacement.cleanup: stop and remove only the exact identity-correlated pilot container, verify post-removal absence, release locks and lease, preserve receipts
cleanup_replacement.tenant_state: seal and retain; do not delete without separate decommission authority
cleanup_replacement.image: remove only if acquired by this run, unused, and not pre-existing
cleanup_replacement.replacement: requires a new pilot package, new nonces, new approvals, and new receipts; no in-place restart or silent substitution

required_receipts: copy request, preflight, creation plan, approval, provision, and structural-isolation receipts
runtime-start proposal, approval, launch-attempt, handshake, heartbeat/current-state, ready or failed receipt
container-isolation proposal, approval, image provenance, launch-attempt, identity, security-profile, mount/denial, ready or failed, cleanup, and post-removal absence evidence

stage18_gate_effect.conditions: only after a non-fixture pilot runtime producer and canonical current-state verifier are implemented and the exact authorized pilot succeeds

cannot_advance.stage17_ledger_closure_backstop: already satisfied independently and not changed by the pilot
cannot_advance.isolation_rules_contract: one bounded mount-denial pilot is not comprehensive customer tenant-isolation proof
cannot_advance.safe_delta_model_contract: the pilot exports or applies no delta
cannot_advance.rogue_recovery_contract: the pilot performs no rogue detection, containment, or replacement
cannot_advance.sla_framework_contract: a 30-second local run is not active service or SLA evidence
cannot_advance.roles_contract: the pilot does not prove a production role/authority matrix
cannot_advance.decommission_contract: bounded cleanup is not customer exit-rights or decommission proof

stop_conditions: operator identity, actor identity, or any exact approval is absent or ambiguous
the pilot runtime artifact and fingerprints are not fixed
the native expiring scope lease is not enforceable
Docker Desktop requires restart, elevation, login, repair, settings, context, daemon, networking, storage, or WSL mutation
any non-pilot container, image, volume, network, mount, port, or process would be changed
the fixed security profile or exact mount set cannot be enforced
source lineage, current state, heartbeat, identity, receipt, or hash validation fails
excluded data is observed or could become reachable
recording would classify fixture evidence as non-fixture or advance more than copy_creation_runtime_proof
rollback: revoke every unconsumed pilot approval and remove the process-scoped actor scopes
stop and remove only the exact pilot container after full identity revalidation
verify the exact container, endpoint, lease, and lock are absent
preserve immutable failure and cleanup receipts plus a hash-only evidence handoff
seal provisioned tenant state without deleting it
restore no Docker setting because the pilot is forbidden from changing settings
require separate decommission authority before deleting tenant state or receipts
operator_decisions_required: confirm Austin as the canonical operator identity for this package
confirm codex.builder as the one-run execution actor
select and approve the fixed non-fixture pilot runtime artifact and its source/image fingerprints
approve implementation of the pilot-only runtime producer and canonical container-to-runtime evidence verifier
approve a native process-scoped expiring and revocable scope lease or choose an existing equivalent enforcement path
approve separate exact-action provisioning, runtime-start, container-isolation, and runtime-evidence decisions after their final fingerprints exist
approve the synthetic input contents and confirm they contain no sensitive data
approve pilot execution in a later instruction
